name: Players
author: Citizen Score
description: Look up any AION 2 character on the Global servers: combat power, item level, stats, gear and Arcana, skills and stigmas, and every Daevanion board node by node. Lists the players around you (fighting, party, nearby; allies and enemies): click one for their gear with Manastones and Theostones, Arcana skill lines, stigma and skill levels, and a card over the game for whoever you fight. Asks NCSOFT's own character site, only when you search, hover or fight.
